Contract ManageLibrarianCRUDService::createLibrarian(librarianid: String,name: String,password: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		existLibs: Set(Librarian) = Librarian.allInstance()->select(l|l.LibrarianID = librarianid)
	precondition:
		existLibs.isEmpty() = true and
		librarianid<>'' and
		name<>'' and
		password<>''
	postcondition:
		let newLib: Librarian in
		newLib.oclIsNew() and
		Librarian.allInstance()->includes(newLib) and
		newLib.LibrarianID = librarianid and
		newLib.Name = name and
		newLib.Password = password and
		result = true
}
